newsitem.title: UK: United seen backing Granada's Yorkshire bid.
newsitem.headline: United seen backing Granada's Yorkshire bid.

text.p: United News & Media Plc is expected to back Granada Group Plc's offer for Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc, the Independent newspaper said on Thursday, citing industry sources.
United News holds 14 percent of Yorkshire.
British newspapers have said Granada is expected to make its formal offer for Yorkshire on Monday or possibly later.

Granada, seeking to buy the 73 percent of Yorkshire it does not already own, has offered 11.75 stg per share and is negotiating for an agreed bid. The Independent said the offer may be increased marginally.
Some institutional shareholders at Yorkshire, notably Mercury Asset Management, are resisting, British newspapers have reported.
